description: This file contains R code demonstrating usage of SparkR for Spark SQL operations, including DataFrame creation, schema inspection, SQL queries, file reading/writing, and Spark session management.

methods.name: sparkR.session
methods.description: Initializes a SparkR session with optional configuration and Hive support.

methods.name: read.json
methods.description: Reads a JSON file into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Displays the first few rows of a DataFrame.

methods.name: showDF
methods.description: Displays the DataFrame in a tabular format.

methods.name: printSchema
methods.description: Prints the schema of a DataFrame.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects columns or expressions from a DataFrame.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Filters rows based on a condition.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of rows in a DataFrame.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Groups DataFrame rows by specified columns.

methods.name: createOrReplaceTempView
methods.description: Creates or replaces a temporary view for SQL queries.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on Spark DataFrames.

methods.name: read.parquet
methods.description: Reads a Parquet file into a DataFrame.

methods.name: write.df
methods.description: Writes a DataFrame to storage in a specified format.

methods.name: write.parquet
methods.description: Writes a DataFrame as a Parquet file.

methods.name: createDataFrame
methods.description: Creates a Spark DataFrame from R data.

methods.name: dapply
methods.description: Applies an R function to a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects Spark DataFrame data into R.

methods.name: sparkR.session.stop
methods.description: Stops the SparkR session.

methods.name: read.jdbc
methods.description: Reads data from a JDBC source into a DataFrame.

methods.name: write.jdbc
methods.description: Writes a DataFrame to a JDBC source.
